title: Transform International (Canada) — Partners in Community Transformation
description: We partner with local organizations in Burundi, Rwanda, Malawi and India so communities can start businesses, finish school and keep clean water flowing. 72 new entrepreneurs in 2026 alone.
_headlineOptions: When communities have the tools, they *transform* their own futures.  ← chosen: hopeful, specific, and echoes the name
Skills, schooling and clean water — built with communities, owned by them.

focus-areas.heading: Local partners lead. We bring the *tools*.
focus-areas.text: We work with local organizations that have “fire in the belly” for change in their own communities. They know their regions best and they are there for the long haul. We help plan the work, bring technical know-how and find the funding.
focus-areas.imageAlt: A woman in a blue top sets up a handwashing bucket with a tap on a green stand.

areas.name: Clean water
areas.text: Wells, tanks and filters that keep safe water flowing in villages, schools and clinics.

areas.name: Sanitation
areas.text: Durable, affordable latrines and community toilets, designed with local builders.

areas.name: Hygiene
areas.text: Handwashing, cleaning and menstrual health that protect patients, families and staff.

areas.name: Food
areas.text: School meals, gardens and nutrition training for mothers of young children.

areas.name: Education
areas.text: School fees, scholarships, and nursery and elementary schools that keep children learning.

areas.name: Skills training
areas.text: Business, trade and sewing skills that turn talent into a steady income.

featured-story.heading: 72 new entrepreneurs. *One graduation.*
featured-story.text: On January 30, 2026, cohorts 7, 8 and 9 of Street Business School graduated together in Gitega. Every one of the 72 participants completed the training — and every one launched a business of their own.
featured-story.imageAlt: Graduates of cohorts 7, 8 and 9 hold up their certificates at their graduation in Gitega, Burundi.

stat.label: average increase in income within 12 months of graduation

outcomes: They start and sustain their own businesses
Graduates begin to create jobs for others

where-we-work.heading: Four countries. *Seven programs.* One approach.
where-we-work.text: From the hills of Gitega to the villages of Bihar, every program is led by people who live there.

project-grid.heading: The work, *program by program*
project-grid.text: Each program has its own local partner, its own goals and its own colour — just like the letters of our name.

quote-band.quote: As a pregnant woman about to deliver my baby, I had to walk a kilometre to fetch water for the labour ward as there was no water supply at the hospital. Now, thanks to STREAMS, we have lots of water, convenient places to wash hands, clean toilets, and more. We are so happy!
quote-band.attribution: A mother in Rumphi District, Malawi
quote-band.context: STREAMS keeps water, sanitation and hygiene working in health facilities.

giving-levels.heading: Your gift, *put to work*
giving-levels.text: Every donation is used by local partners who know exactly where it will make the biggest difference.

ways-to-help.heading: There’s more than one way to *transform*
ways-to-help.text: Give today, plan a lasting gift, lend your skills or rally your friends. Every kind of help counts.

items.title: Donate
items.text: Give to the program of your choice, or wherever the need is greatest right now.

items.title: Leave a legacy
items.text: A gift in your will, of stock, or from an RRSP, RRIF or TFSA can change lives for generations.

items.title: Volunteer
items.text: Technical or admin support here in Canada, or helping a program abroad — there’s room for your skills.

items.title: Fundraise
items.text: Share a campaign on Facebook, present to your Rotary Club, or introduce friends who want to make a difference.
